doc.title: Josephine Davies interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 14, 2025

title: Closing remarks and goodbyes
summary: Rowe mentions Nik Kershaw, thanks her and they say goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: I’m happy to hear that. And before I go I wanted to say, you were talking about ‘80s pop music, well over here we were absolutely nuts about Nik Kershaw.
He had a – you know he was just great. Anyway this has been a really wonderful conversation. I’m very pleased we were able to do it, and I wish you all the best in the future.
Thank you so much, it was really wonderful to talk with you.
All right. I’ll pause here and we’ll say our good-byes. Thanks a lot, Josephine.
